source.name: Canada Soccer Pressroom - Canada Soccer, NIKE release new CANMNT 2026 kits
source.note: Kit maker, not a shirt sponsor in the front/back/sleeve sense. National team match shirts carry no commercial sponsors. Footy Headlines' official launch coverage (2026-03-16, footyheadlines.com/2025/11/nike-canada-2026-world-cup-home-kit.html) describes every mark on the home shirt — a tonal maple leaf pattern, a white Swoosh, black detailing on the sleeve cuffs and sides, and a collar patch 'FROM COAST TO COAST TO COAST' — and its launch photos show the shirt front, back and shorts: no commercial sponsor on any placement.
source.quote: Canada Soccer and Nike today unveiled the new Canada Men’s National Team kits for 2026

summary: No sponsors on the shirt: Nike's 2026 World Cup home shirt (red with a tonal maple leaf pattern) carries only the white Swoosh, the Canada crest and the bilingual 'From coast to coast to coast' collar patch; the launch release and Footy Headlines' description and photos show no commercial sponsor on any placement.
